title: Repair orphaned dashboard metrics causing blank incident panels
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Several customers escalated during a cross-region incident that key console incident panels rendered blank or showed 'no data' for important SLO and latency histograms. The issue manifests across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. This ticket tracks the investigation, temporary mitigation, and the production fix for dashboard widgets that lost their metric source bindings ("orphaned metrics").
background_and_scope: On 2026-03-09 we received three customer escalations (one enterprise Dedicated customer, a Hosted PLG user, and a Private VPC deployment) reporting missing widgets on the Incident Overview and SLO dashboards. Affected widgets included 99th percentile latency, token throughput, and regional error-rate heatmaps. The issue appeared during a simultaneous metrics ingestion spike and rolling config propagate; it impacted dashboards in both new and pre-existing workspaces. This is not limited to a single model or cluster; it's observable across runtime, ingestion, and console surfaces.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open Incident Overview dashboard for a workspace that experienced a metrics ingestion spike
2) Observe SLO pane and latency histograms — some widgets show 'no data' while metric explorer shows raw series
3) Query Prometheus/Grafana backend for the same metric; metrics exist but widget binding is unresolved
4) Reproduces intermittently after a config refresh or when console service restarts
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: dashboard widget binding table in console metadata store lost references when a config migration job retried and applied deduplication logic
We reproduced locally by running the config migration with dedupe=true against a copy of a workspace metadata DB
Observed that certain metric source IDs were remapped and the widget->metric mapping rows were not updated due to a failed transaction during an ingestion-backfill window
Trace gaps: links from console UI to trace-service were returning 404s because widget meta lacked trace_id prefixes after the failed commit
Logs: console-service produced a flurry of 'metric-source-not-found' warnings at 2026-03-09T18:12:xxZ from all regions
Related infra: config propagate job v2.7.3 had a retry path that skipped patching dependent mappings in edge cases
actions_taken_so_far: Created workspace-level safe mode that serves cached dashboard snapshots to affected customers (deployed 2026-03-10 03:00 UTC)
Rolled back config propagate job to v2.7.2 in regions with highest customer reports (deployed 2026-03-10 05:30 UTC)
Applied a read-only repair script to map orphaned widgets to available metric sources for 12 high-priority workspaces (manual fixes applied 2026-03-11)
Notified impacted customers with status updates and temporary dashboard snapshots (customer success & support communications)
root_cause_analysis: Race condition in config propagate v2.7.3 where deduplication logic would remap metric-source IDs while a concurrent ingestion-backfill transaction was inserting dependent widget mappings. The propagate job's retry logic performed a partial upsert without transactional guarantees across the two metadata tables, resulting in orphaned widget rows referencing non-existent metric-source IDs. The console UI then surfaced 'no data' because the widget lookup failed, even though raw metrics continued to arrive in the ingestion pipeline.
proposed_fix: 1) Update config propagate job to perform transactional remap: ensure widget->metric mapping updates occur in same atomic step as source remap (DB transaction or two-phase commit emulation)
2) Add strong integration tests simulating concurrent propagate + ingestion-backfill to prevent regressions
3) Write a one-time migration that scans metadata for orphaned widget rows and rebinds them to best-effort metric sources using stable name heuristics
4) Add an alert for 'widget-binding-failures' with counts and workspace attribution to detect reoccurrence
rollback_and_mitigation_plan: Continue serving cached dashboard snapshots for affected workspaces until migration completes
If migration causes regression, roll propagate job back to v2.7.2 (we already validated rollback path)
Support will continue manual reparations for any VIP customers until automatic migration finishes
testing_and_validation: Integration test added to pipeline that simulates concurrent propagate + backfill and asserts no orphaned mappings remain
Staging migration run validated on mirror of 30 workspaces, zero orphaned widgets after migration (2026-03-13)
Post-deploy smoke: sample 100 random workspaces and ensure 100% of incident dashboard widgets resolve a metric source within 10s
rollout_plan: Canary: console-2026.03+migration on 10% of workspaces in us-east-1 for 2h (2026-03-15 02:00 UTC)
Monitor 'widget-binding-failures' alert and customer reports for 24h
Gradual ramp to 100% over 48h if no regressions observed
monitoring_and_alerting: New metric: console.widget_binding.failures (counter) with workspace and region tags
Grafana dashboard panel for widget_binding.failures and orphaned_widget_count by workspace
Pager policy: P1 on >10 failures across >=3 workspaces in <30m
customer_notifications: 2026-03-10: Initial Acknowledgement sent to impacted customers via Support
2026-03-11: Temporary snapshot dashboards provided; manual remaps applied for VIPs
2026-03-14: Notified customers of planned automatic migration and canary schedule
final_resolution: Planned: implement transactional remap in propagate job and run the safe migration. After canary validation and monitoring, perform full rollout. Expected to fully resolve orphaned widgets and eliminate 'no data' panels. Post-incident retrospective scheduled for 2026-03-22 to capture lessons and harden config propagate job.
notes_for_oncall: If you see surge in console.widget_binding.failures, pause propagation, enable cached snapshots, and contact ENG on-call. Use the repair script in tools/console/repair_orphaned_widgets.sh for emergency manual remaps.
